name: Destroyers Cricket Club
homeGround: Divisional Cricket Stadium, Neem Chauraha / APSU Stadium
description: The reigning three-time champion powerhouse of the Atal Bihari Vajpayee Memorial Tournament, captained by premier all-rounder Pranav Dwivedi. Renowned for disciplined tactical bowling, explosive middle-order aggression, and a dominant 19-15 series rivalry record.

name: Dread Eleven Cricket Club
homeGround: Martand School Ground No. 3 / Neem Chauraha Stadium
description: The fierce, relentless arch-rivals of Destroyers CC, captained by top-order talisman Akhil Mishra. Inaugural winners of the tournament with three consecutive titles from 2021 to 2023, playing an aggressive, high-octane brand of cricket.
